title: The Customer filter finds customers, including one with only a credit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is Markup % 25.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for Part Sales in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, put on tier A for Part Sales in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A, with a part in category A priced $20.00 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Before the day of the test, have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 2, for customer B, with a part in category A priced $20.00 by tier A, invoiced; return it on the test day.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick Custom range in the Date filter with today as From and To.
  3. Type customer B's name in the Customer filter's search.
  4. Tick customer B.
  5. Tick customer A.
  6. Clear the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • The report shows today's range: customer B's one activity today is the return's credit.

Step 3:

  • Customer B is found.

Step 4:

  • Customer B's lines show: tier A with Parts Invoiced $0.00 and Parts Credits −$20.00 (1 × $20.00).

Step 5:

  • Customers A and B's lines show together; tier A's row reads Parts Invoiced $20.00 from customer A.

Step 6:

  • Every customer's lines show again.
